{{2025 Diamond League}}
The '''2025 [[Memorial Van Damme]]''' was the 49th edition of the annual outdoor track and field meeting in [[Brussels]], [[Belgium]]. Held on 22 August at the [[King Baudouin Stadium]], it was the fourteenth leg of the [[2025 Diamond League]] – the highest level international track and field circuit.

== Diamond+ events results ==
Starting in 2025 a new discipline of events was added called Diamond+, these 4 events per meet<ref>{{cite web |title=Diamond+ Disciplines announced for first four meetings |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/news/general/diamond-disciplines-announced-for-first-four-meetings/ |website=Diamond League |access-date=9 April 2025 |date=3 March 2025}}</ref> awarded athletes with increased prize money whilst keeping the standard points format to qualify for the Diamond league finals. First place earns 8 points, with each step down in place earning one less point than the previous, until no points are awarded in 9th place or lower. In the case of a tie, each tying athlete earns the full amount of points for the place.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://worldathletics.org/download/download?filename=b1d1b93a-33cf-406a-82b2-18d9db5b32d2.pdf&urlslug=C1.3%20-%20Diamond%20League%20Regulations%20(2025%20Status%20Requirements)|title=Diamond League Meetings Regulations 2025 Status Requirements|access-date=9 April 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Rules & Format |url=https://www.diamondleague.com/about/rules-format/ |access-date=25 April 2025 |website=Diamond League |archive-date=17 April 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250417034948/https://www.diamondleague.com/about/rules-format/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
